tool_args.rationale: Five observations at a single horizon and fixed x_now and s_grad do not identify the bridge mechanism or its dependence on those variables. The open-branch probe can discriminate the competing mechanisms.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot varies only u_now, so a saturating snapshot law cannot be distinguished reliably from a mobility bridge.
The cheaper open-branch probe is better targeted to the unresolved mechanism.
It is unrelated to the mechanism ambiguity.
